title: Chapter 700
paragraphs: Chapter 700
Episode 178. Deepening Concern (4)
Jin liked all the sudden actions that Veil showed since they came to Kinzelo's new headquarters.
He was annoyed by Zephirin's threats and felt like he was hit by Orgal's non-joking jokes. However, Veil was standing up for him refreshing.
Kinzelo blinked his eyes for a while without answering Veil's harsh words.
"Well, Veil. How about holding back a little? If you rashly attack, it seems like you'll be the one to explode."
Jin seemed to be trying to stop Veil, but in reality, it was the opposite.
What Jin said now could have two effects at once.
First, it further stimulated Veil, and second, it showed to Kinzelo's side that he was making an effort to keep Veil in check.
As expected, Veil yelled even more furiously at Jin's words.
[No way!]
"What do you mean no? You're definitely losing. Orgal is indeed a Demon King. So, don't make more trouble and stay still."
For Jin, he wanted to see Orgal dealing with Veil.
'It's likely that I won't be able to see Orgal's fight in detail during the final battle. I have to focus entirely on Rosa.'
So, it wasn't a bad idea to take the chance to see how the rejuvenated Orgal would fight in advance. It would be a different dimension from the incident at the Sword Emperor City.
[Ha, Jin. This is something you don't understand. Yeah, he might be stronger than me. But I can feel it.]
"What can you feel?"
[He can't kill me.]
"Well, that's obvious. We're a temporary alliance, aren't we? You're one of the most important forces."
[It's not just that, it's a more essential problem. He can't kill me with the power he has. That's why I want to fight him, even if I get hit.]
Jin looked at Orgal as if asking him to explain what he meant.

[Without the energy of Changseong, or something equivalent, it's impossible to completely erase a trace of life. There are very rare beings like that... like the King of the Black Sea, who you've fought against in the past.]
"So the term 'completely', implies that only killing is impossible, but sealing or other things are possible. That's why you guys didn't even show your noses when Gliac woke up..."
Jin, recalling the Sword Emperor City incident, gritted his teeth. Back then, Kinzelo had asked for Jin's loyalty in exchange for their participation in the Gliac war.
[Veil, if you really want to fight me, I have no choice but to seal part of your power. To prevent fatal problems in our alliance. That's why Jin will try harder to stop you.]
"Well, that's my plan. It's a particularly unlucky day today, Orgal."
[It's not different from usual.]
Without the energy of Changseong, or something equivalent, it is impossible to kill a trace of life.
Jin took a moment to think about that fact.
'So in the end, to kill Orgal in the future, I will definitely need the power of Changseong.'
Considering the power that Orgal originally possessed, excluding the characteristics of the authority of the Sun God, the power of Changseong would have been needed anyway.
However, there was one strange thing.
'But that day at the seal ground... Why did Veil admit defeat to me like that? According to Orgal's words, I shouldn't have been able to kill Veil.'
Seeing how Veil was now barking at Orgal, Veil was never the type to submit just because the opponent was stronger.
Although Veil had never met the Sun God, he recognized that he was a divine being, and was thus arrogant and willful.
'Did he know that I was a descendant of Sara?'
It was not a problem to worry about now.
At Jin's signal, Veil, who had been glaring at Orgal with a grin, turned his eyes.
"I think we've roughly kept our promises to each other, Orgal. Let's discuss Rosa as allies now."
[About the reason Rosa is being completed faster than I expected?]
"Yes. There are also a few strange things about Rosa's actions."
[Tell me.]

"First of all, Rosa now has become such a massive evil that even strong people like Padler, who nearly beat you to a pulp in the Caldron Snowfield, are unnecessary. It's hard to explain the evidence, as it's something I've personally felt."
[Since you wouldn't be talking nonsense about this issue, I'll believe you. It's not entirely impossible either.]

"But Rosa, who is like that, is suddenly using Joshua again. Moreover, he gave off a more incompetent vibe than before, and he failed all the tasks he had recently undertaken. I stopped them all. What I find strange is exactly this point."
[Are you saying there's no reason for the demon to use such a trivial character?]
"Yes. After meeting him in Akin, I've been thinking. What on earth is the reason for Rosa to keep such a useless person by his side...."
Jin took a few seconds to organize his thoughts and then made eye contact with Orgal.
"Suddenly, I remembered what you said at the first meeting."
- Her daughters only have one wish. The advent of my old lover, Heluram.
- So they're using humans as sacrifices?
- Not exactly humans themselves. Human flesh and bones are necessary, of course, but the efficiency isn't very good. It's despair. Only a large amount of high-purity despair can awaken Heluram.
Despair.
Jin speculated that Rosa might be using Joshua to obtain high-purity despair.
As Jin explained this, Orgal looked a little surprised, his eyes widening.
"If not, I thought there would be no reason for Rosa to keep that trash by his side."
[...That's a really interesting story, Jin Lun Kandel. Then, it's likely not unrelated to the quick completion of the demon.]
"Do you think my assumption is correct?"

[I had forgotten about the second generation of Lun Kandel because he was so insignificant. Human jealousy can sometimes be so great that it surprises even the gods. If the magnitude of his inferiority complex is deep and dark enough to be meaningful to the demon, it could be possible. This is an area I had not thought of at all.]
"So... does that mean it's inconvenient for Rosa if Joshua accomplishes his tasks well?"
However, he could not deliberately lose to Joshua to prevent Rosa from harvesting his despair.
Because whatever he does, if he succeeds in a task given by Rosa, it would mean that Jin and those around him would be hurt or die.
There was only one solution.
To completely eliminate Joshua by finding him. So that Rosa cannot use him at all.
[Yes, it seems so.]
"The only way to deal with this is to completely eradicate Joshua."
[It won't be easy since the demon is likely protecting him directly.]
It was an obvious statement.
Rosa would not leave such a useful character unattended. A clever and meticulous protection must be in place so that Joshua could not detect it, but no one else could destroy it completely.
This was also why Veil missed Joshua in the forest of Akin.
"Protection, protection... ugh."
Suddenly, Jin was overwhelmed by a terrible feeling of nausea.
It was because he was disgusted.
The fact that there was a human who, even after falling into a despair-producing doll, could not escape from the one who made him that way.
The fact that there was a mother who, even after sending her child from the abyss to a deeper abyss, was indifferent if it was necessary for her.
[Are you okay?]
Jin nodded his head, barely holding back the nausea that was surging up like madness.
"I'm fine. Anyway, whether my assumption is correct or not, Joshua must be eliminated before the final battle."

[I think so too. After all, if the day comes when Joshua Lun Kandel lives without despair, it will be your despair. You are a much more meaningful existence to the demon than Joshua... Your despair will be a much better ingredient than his. Waking Heluram...]
Jin now doubted whether despair really was used to bring about Heluram's advent.
Rosa, who he saw a while ago, seemed not to be waking up Heluram, but preparing to become a disaster of that magnitude herself.
Above all, Jin couldn't imagine Rosa pledging her loyalty to Heluram like a prophet. Whose subordinate was Rosa, really?
'Damn... The worries just keep getting deeper.'
If there was any consolation,
it was the fact that Orgal just regained some of his old power.
"So you've got your work cut out for you now, Orgal. You've been resting in bed, it's time to move."
[Are you telling me to kill Joshua?]
"You wouldn't be saying it's hard with only that much power regained, would you?"

[Well, it depends on how much the demon cares. But I was thinking of looking for him even without you saying it. If the demon's protection is so deep that even my power cannot handle it, let's just confirm it first. Whether his despair is really being used by the demon.]
"Good, it makes me feel more and more rewarded for bringing Veil. I'll look forward to meaningful news next time we meet."
As Jin seemed to be about to leave, Orgal waved his hand and opened a steel dimensional gate. The seascape of Tican could be seen beyond the gate.
[Use it if you want.]
Outwardly, it seemed like a consideration, but Jin recognized it as a warning disguised as a consideration.
As an ally, if he did something reckless, he could find Tican in an instant.
Unlike before, Orgal did not seem to strain himself to open the gate.
"I have the ship I came on. You know, it's a space mover."
When Jin responded with the same warning, Orgal smirked.
"Well, as you said, it's a contingency. See you next time."
After leaving the headquarters of Kinzelo and boarding the Red Owl, Veil looked at Jin as if perplexed.
"Hey, Jin."
"Why?"
"The reason I lost to you at first was because of the fire you have."
Jin was about to ask why he said that all of a sudden, but he remembered that he had been pondering that reason back in Kinzelo's meeting room.
"Is that so? I was wondering a bit ago. It didn't seem like it was just because I was stronger, but if it was because of the fire, then was that correct?"
"No, you seem not to know, but the fire you have is very special. And that fire will work on him, too. So, be sure to beat him with me someday. Got it?"
